provenance: Actual Electron renderer with synthetic tasks; no real agents or operations
checks: six lanes separate waiting dependencies from failures, retain cancellation labels and failure reasons, and render each task as one keyboard button
task sheets trap focus, restore their opener, follow prerequisites by identity, and open the recorded session without launching anything
queued tasks cannot race the dispatcher; parked tasks must be brought back before Start appears
parking sends the selected task and future timestamp; bring-back and retry follow refreshed graph state without inventing completion
Start routes the selected task and provider exactly once; a refused launch keeps its recorded Ready state and reports the error
project changes withhold old-scope tasks; late reads cannot replace the current scope and failed switches never relabel old data
a pending launch locks its controls and its late completion cannot replace a newly selected project
failed refreshes retain readable records but disable mutations; removed selected tasks expose no stale actions
search and state filters survive navigation; an empty filter has a working path back to every task
only an observed lane change animates a task; the detail sheet and task motion respect Off and system Reduce Motion
narrow desktop keeps overflow inside the board, retains the final lane, and fits the task sheet in both themes
empty Board retains the planning flow; opening or leaving the planner makes no model call
